title: A former partner shares a private image
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes intimate images shared without permission by a former partner. Consent to create or privately send the image does not authorize later publication.
suggested_beats: A private image is entrusted to a partner.
It is shared after the relationship ends.
Report the abuse and seek support.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone whose former partner breaks their trust
why_it_works: A prior relationship gives the abuser access to private material.

title: An image threat is used to prevent separation
mechanism_summary: An official guide describes threats to release intimate images to keep someone in a relationship. The material becomes a tool of control rather than a consensual exchange.
suggested_beats: A partner holds private images.
Leaving triggers an exposure threat.
Seek safe support for the coercion.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone trying to leave a controlling relationship
why_it_works: Fear of exposure can make leaving feel unsafe.

title: A private live chat is secretly recorded
mechanism_summary: An online safety guide warns that intimate live chats can be captured without the participant knowing. The recording may then be shared beyond the intended conversation.
suggested_beats: A video chat seems private.
A recording circulates elsewhere.
Report the sharing without blaming the target.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone trusting a private video conversation
why_it_works: A live interaction can feel temporary even when another person records it.

title: An intimate image is turned into a mocking meme
mechanism_summary: An official guide describes private images being edited into memes and shared. The change in presentation does not remove the lack of consent.
suggested_beats: A private image is obtained.
A mocking edit spreads through messages.
Do not forward it; report the abuse.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone targeted by peers or acquaintances
why_it_works: Humor can be used to disguise a violation of privacy.

title: A recipient forwards an image to peers
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes intimate images being passed on beyond the person who received them. A private exchange becomes wider exposure without the depicted person's agreement.
suggested_beats: An image is shared with one person.
That recipient forwards it.
Receiving an image does not permit redistribution.
why_it_works: Trust in one person cannot control what that person later shares.

title: A hidden recording violates an intimate setting
mechanism_summary: An official guide includes nonconsensual recordings of private activities as image-based abuse. Sharing such material extends the original privacy violation.
suggested_beats: Someone expects privacy.
An intimate recording is shared.
Report the recording and distribution.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone recorded in a private setting
why_it_works: The target may have no opportunity to prevent a concealed recording.

title: A photo exchange is a publication trap
mechanism_summary: An enforcement complaint describes an operator posing as another person to solicit intimate photographs. The photographs were then posted publicly without permission.
suggested_beats: An apparent private exchange begins.
Submitted images appear on a public site.
Report the publication and impersonation.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone deceived about a private recipient
why_it_works: Apparent reciprocity can create trust in a false identity.

title: Personal details accompany an abusive upload
mechanism_summary: An enforcement complaint describes a site collecting intimate images alongside identifying information. Publishing them together exposed targets to unwanted contact from strangers.
suggested_beats: An image is submitted without consent.
Personal information directs strangers to the target.
Report both the image and exposed information.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone whose private imagery is publicly linked to them
why_it_works: Connecting imagery to contact details intensifies exposure and intrusion.
